description: This file defines a mock class ActiveRequestsMock for unit testing, which implements the IActiveRequests interface related to media request management in the Rialto server component. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing interactions with active media requests.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IActiveRequests interface for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for managing media request lifecycle and segments.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Mocks inserting a new media source request with a specified maximum media bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media source type for a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Mocks erasing a request by request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Mocks erasing requests by media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Mocks adding a media segment to a request.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media segments associated with a request.
